name: Melao B3 5% Niacinamide Serum 30ml
description:
Melao B3 5% Niacinamide Serum – 30ml
For Acne, Dark Spots & Uneven Skin

Origin: Made in China 🇨🇳

Key Benefits:

Helps reduce acne and breakouts

Minimizes hyperpigmentation and dark spots

Reduces scarring and uneven skin texture

Helps shrink oversized pores

Fights signs of premature aging

Active Ingredient: 5% Niacinamide for smoother, clearer, and healthier-looking skin
